items.title: Warren Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 17, 2018
items.q: I’ll just wrap up with you are doing a road trip here with the trio of Joseph Daley and Scott Robinson

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m optimistic that I’ll be able to hold my breath for three more years. And then we’ll see what happens. But I’m not going to be completely despondent if another poor choice gets in. Because I’ve seen poor choices get in and I’ve lived through them you know. It just means that there are areas where things might be a little bit more difficult for me, but temporarily you know. So you know, I feel good about life.

I’ll just wrap up with you are doing a road trip here with the trio of Joseph Daley and Scott Robinson, who by the way if you recall I said don’t say anything bad about us. But they’re not here. But do you have a sense of what you’d like people to take away from your performance tonight?

Last night we played. This is only the second concert on the tour. The first one, you know, we usually get a — but people came up to me on two or three occasions and said, “I felt you.” And if I can get that kind of a reaction then I’m happy. You know they could see that I was doing something that was reaching out and that they could grab and pull back on. And I can’t ask for any more than that.
